description: This file is a PHP source file defining the 'ViewConfiguretabs' class, which manages the administrative interface for configuring tabs in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for rendering the setup page, handling access control, and initializing template variables used in the user interface.

classes.name: ViewConfiguretabs
classes.description: Represents the administrative view for configuring module tabs in SuiteCRM, extending SugarView. Handles access control, data retrieval for enabled/disabled tabs, and renders the corresponding configuration template.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the title parameters (including a link) for this module's page, used in page headers.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Checks if current user has admin privileges before displaying the page; terminates execution if unauthorized.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the configuration interface, prepares data for enabled/disabled tabs and panels, assigns variables to the Smarty template, and displays the ConfigureTabs.tpl page.
